# DigiRise India LLM Instructions

## About DigiRise India
DigiRise India is a performance marketing and digital growth agency based in Kolkata, India. We specialize in Data-Driven SEO, Meta Ads, B2B Lead Generation, and AI Automation.

- Focus: Performance First
- Tools: ROI Calculator, Meta Tag Generator, Speed Checker, AI Copy Generator
- Framework: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Vite, Vercel Serverless

## Services
